Tests batch URI extraction with per-input config (extract_batch)

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
from xberg import extract_batch

async def main() -> None:
    inputs = [{"config": {"output_format": "markdown"}, "kind": "uri", "uri": "https://example.com/pdf/fake_memo.pdf"}]
    result = await extract_batch(inputs)
    for result in result.results:
        print(result.content)

asyncio.run(main())
```
